name: WooFlow – Previous & Next Order Navigation for WooCommerce
author: WpBelo

sections.description:
Process WooCommerce orders faster with single-click navigation links directly inside the order edit screen.

WooFlow – Previous & Next Order Navigation for WooCommerce adds two smart buttons — Previous Order and Next Order — so you can review and process orders sequentially without going back to the orders list every time.

Ideal for store managers, support teams, fulfillment staff, and anyone who regularly navigates between multiple WooCommerce orders.

🚀 Used on 2000+ WooCommerce Stores Worldwide

This plugin is actively developed and maintained by professional WordPress developers at WpBelo, the team behind multiple WooCommerce tools and agency plugins.

🟢 Fully Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS

Supports both traditional and High-Performance Order Storage mode.

✨ Free Version Features

The core plugin is 100% free and includes:

  • Previous Order link on the order edit screen
  • Next Order link on the order edit screen
  • Works with WooCommerce HPOS
  • Uses WooCommerce native button styling
  • Translation ready (WPML, LocoTranslate, Polyglot, Translatepress etc.. compatible)
  • Zero-clutter, lightweight code

Simple, effective, and saves time immediately.

🔥 PRO Version Features (optional upgrade)

Want to filter which orders you navigate through? Upgrade to the PRO version and unlock productivity tools used by high-volume stores.

PRO includes:

  • Order List Navigation (respects filters & sorting)
  • Lane-Based Order Workflows
  • Advanced Order Status Filtering
  • Order Amount & Date Filtering
  • Specific Product Matching
  • Specific Customer Filtering (VIP / Wholesale)
  • Payment Method & Refund Filtering
  • Shipping & Fulfillment Filtering (country, method, class)
  • Per-User Navigation Mode
  • Smart Order Direction Logic
  • Import & Export Workflow Configurations
  • Priority Support
  • 1 Year Updates

sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for WooFlow – Previous & Next Order Navigation for WooCommerce
  3. Install and activate

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire previous-next-edit-order-links-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate via the Plugins menu

After activation

  1. If you have a pro version, you can configure your settings from the “WooFlow” admin menu option
  2. Open any WooCommerce order

3. Use the Previous or Next buttons in the top admin bar to navigate
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It adds navigation links to WooCommerce order edit pages so you can jump to the next or previous order without returning to the order list.

Do I need the PRO version?

The FREE version is perfect if you just want fast navigation.

Upgrade to PRO if you want:
– Order list navigation
– Preset workflow lanes navigation
– Only specific order statuses
– Skip cancelled / refunded orders
– Date-based navigation

Does it work with HPOS?

Yes. Full High-Performance Order Storage support is included in both FREE and PRO versions.

Will it slow down my site?

No.
This plugin runs only in the admin dashboard and loads no frontend assets.

Is it translation ready?

Yes. WPML and multilingual support included.

Where can I get PRO?
